search_text: published ZDI-11-139 ZDI-CAN-1035 Webkit Anonymous Frame Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2011-04-19 9.0 AV:N/AC:L/Au:N/C:P/I:P/A:C ['WebKit'] ['WebKit'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of Apple Safari Webkit. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious page or open a malicious file. The specific flaw exists within the library's implementation of a frame element. When parsing a malformed document embedded inside an SVG document, the library will create an anonymous block around a frame element in the block's contents. When freeing this anonymous block via an assignment to the read-only .textContent attribute, a reference to one of the child elements will still exist. Accessing this child element can then lead to code execution under the context of the application. Webkit fix: http://trac.webkit.org/changeset/81611 ['2011-03-31 - Vulnerability reported to vendor', '2011-04-19 - Coordinated public release of advisory'] wushi of team509 https://www.zerodayinitiative.com/advisories/ZDI-11-139/
title: Webkit Anonymous Frame Remote Code Execution Vulnerability

When freeing this anonymous block via an assignment to the read-only .textContent attribute, a reference to one of the child elements will still exist. Accessing this child element can then lead to code execution under the context of the application.
